title: An upper bound on the smallest singular value of dense random combinatorial matrices
summary: Let $M$ be an $n\times n$ random matrix with entries in $\{0, 1\}$, where each row is independently and uniformly sampled from the set of all vectors in $\{0, 1\}^n$ containing exactly $d$ ones, with $d=pn$ for some fixed constant $p\in (0,1/2]$. A recent result of Tran states that the smallest singular value $s_n(M)$ is bounded below by $c_p n^{-1/2}$ with high probability.
